overview.text: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) invites bids, limited to its Empaneled Bidders, for system study, design, development, testing and implementation of a Mobile App for managing Unsolicited Commercial Communication (Android and iOS) and a Reporting Dashboard/Portal, hosted on NIC Cloud in New Delhi. The contract covers one (01) year of free warranty support after Go-live followed by two (02) years of maintenance. Ref. No. IT-6/1/4(1)/2021-IT.

summary.issuing_organization: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI); Technical Officer (IT); Ref. No. IT-6/1/4(1)/2021-IT; Mahanagar Doorsanchar Bhawan, J.L. Nehru Marg (Old Minto Road), New Delhi - 110002; bid queries: it-eoirfp@trai.gov.in

scope.text: Design, develop, test and implement a Mobile App for managing Unsolicited Commercial Communication for consumers, on both Android and iOS platforms.
Develop a Reporting Portal: TRAI login with filter-based reports downloadable as csv, excel or pdf, and published interactive reports for consumers.
Build an interactive UCC dashboard with analytics and reports such as total complaints, complaint status, TSP-wise, LSA-wise, complaint category and header reports.
App features include OTP validation through the TSP, DND preference setting as per schedule II of TCCCPR, 2018, UCC SMS/call complaints, consent revocation, appeals and header query.
End-to-end API integration and API testing of the App and Portal with TSP platforms, plus bug fixing support to TSPs; Annexure E gives the indicative API set.
Deploy, host and monitor the App and Portal on NIC Cloud virtual machines provided by TRAI, optimizing resource utilization.
Maintenance for two (02) years after the warranty period: bug fixing, patches, quarterly app updates, backups, monitoring and quarterly status reports, as per Annexure B.
Exhaustive training to TRAI officials, TSPs, Appellate Authority and other stakeholders, with e-learning videos, PowerPoint and PDF training material.

key_requirements.text: Apps must include accessibility features and Portals must comply with Govt. of India accessibility guidelines and WCAG 2.0.
All Apps and Portals must be bilingual, in both Hindi and English.
Must use open-source technologies for development, avoiding any product or periodic license fees.
Must get a security audit of the entire software done through a CERT-IN empaneled agency at the EB's cost, fix all reported vulnerabilities and get the audit cleared.
Must ensure 99% uptime, and the system must not be down for more than 4 hours in a given instance.
App must have a feature to mark SPAM calls through machine learning.
Must deliver project management documents, SRS, source code with walk-through document, test reports including TSP-wise API test report, manuals and the mobile app signing key.
Must keep up-to-date Android App, iOS App and Portal source code in a repository such as GITLAB identified by TRAI; apps are released only from repository code.
Must appoint a full-time project manager as Primary Point of Contact and a Secondary Point of Contact; team members must not be changed without TRAI consent.
Desirable: the architecture should support multiple concurrent users (like 500 sessions) without delay in response.

eligibility.text: Bidding is limited to TRAI Empaneled Bidders; the RFP is addressed to Team Computers, Phimetrics Technologies, Spice Digital, NetCreative Mind Solutions, Akal Information Systems and Red Mango Analytics.
Eligibility and compliance with all technical forms of Annexure C is the first level of evaluation; only bids meeting the eligibility criteria are technically evaluated.
Not specified in the document: no turnover, net worth, certification, JV/consortium or blacklisting criteria are stated.

important_dates.text: Bid schedule shows the reference date as dt.04.11.2021.
Last date for pre-bid clarifications in writing: 18.10.2021.
Last date and time for bid submission: 02.11.2021 (14:30 hrs).
Financial bid opening (Envelope B): date to be intimated to technically qualified EBs.
Bids must remain valid for 60 days after the date of bid opening.
Objection to the work order must be reported within three (03) working days of receipt, otherwise it is deemed accepted.

commercial_requirements.text: Not specified in the document: no EMD/bid security or tender fee is stated.
Performance Bank Guarantee of three (3) percent of development and security audit charges, valid three (3) months beyond completion of the warranty period.
Before the AMC period, a second PBG of three (3) percent of the total AMC amount for 02 years, valid three (3) months beyond the AMC period.
Development payments: Project plan 10%, SRS 10%, source code 10%, UAT & Go live 60%, satisfactory warranty & support completion 10%.
Maintenance (2 years) paid in 4 bi-annual installments on satisfactory service; payments are electronic, after TDS and penalty deductions.
Prices quoted exclusive of taxes in Annexure D (development with 1 year warranty, AMC for 2 years, security audit); man-month rates capped at NICSI Tier-III.
Delay penalty of 2.5% of total project cost per week, up to a maximum of 20% of total project cost.
SLA: critical faults within 24 Hours, else Rs. 200 Per Day (max 5% of AMC charges per annum); non-critical within 72 Hours, else 7 days free maintenance extension (max 30 days per annum).

project_duration.text: Development period is not fixed in the RFP; bidders propose a detailed activity plan, scored under Proposed Timelines.
Warranty: one (1) year, free of cost, from Go-live and complete acceptance of the project.
Maintenance: two (02) years after completion of the warranty period.
TRAI may extend the maintenance period; financials for the extended period must not exceed 10% of the maintenance cost quoted in the bid.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: Combined Quality Cum Cost Based System (CQCCBS) with 70% weightage to technical score and 30% to financial; the highest combined score out of 100 wins.
Evaluation: Bids scoring less than 75 technical marks are disqualified and their financial bids are not opened.
Evaluation: Technical marks: Experience 15, Understanding of project 10, Development methodology and solution 40, Architecture and security 10, Timelines 10, Maintenance methodology 15.
Evaluation: Experience scored at 1 mark per work order for telecom/broadcasting app and portal work, Govt work over 15 lakh in the last 3 years, and STQC-certified GIGW-compliant portals.
Evaluation: Lowest cost proposal gets a financial score of 100; others are scored inversely proportional to price (LEC / EC).
Submission: Two sealed envelopes, A 'Technical Bid' (Annexure C) and B 'Financial Bid' (Annexure D), inside a marked outer envelope sent by Post/Courier/By Hand to Technical Officer (IT), TRAI.
Submission: Bid signed by an authorized person with authorization letter, every page initialed, no unattested overwriting; formats must be strictly followed or information is not evaluated.
Submission: Technical bid must include the RFP signed with seal, authorisation letter and documents for each technical criterion; EBs may be asked to present.
Risk: Date conflict: the covering letter is dated 04 October, 2021 but the bid schedule gives the reference date as 04.11.2021, after the submission deadline.
Risk: Bid opening conflict: the covering letter says bids open at TRAI office, while Section 7 says opening will be held online with a link shared.
Risk: Vague scope: features and dashboard reports are finalized only during requirement gathering, APIs are indicative, and appeal APIs are to be finalized in phase 2.
Risk: Minor enhancements must be provided free of cost during execution and AMC period, with no definition of minor versus major.
Risk: Open-ended confidentiality liability: EB must fully compensate TRAI for any breach, TRAI's decision on quantum is final, and the contract can be terminated without notice.
Risk: Terms of the EOI dated 9th January, 2018, its two corrigenda and the Master Service Agreement are part of this RFP but not reproduced in it.
